name: NGC 59 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 59, a nearby galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc59-hubble
story: A neighbor of the Milky Way that Hubble observed to measure its distance from the brightness of its brightest red giant stars, part of a project to map how the galaxies around us are arranged and how they move.

claims.text: NGC 59 is a target of Hubble program 13442 on nearby galaxies
The program measures distances to nearby galaxies from the tip of the red giant branch and maps their distribution and motions
